## What's Changed

### Fixes
The cape clipping into the body on 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 when the chestplate is fully hidden (below 5% transparency) has been fixed - by @zannagh in [#391](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/391). Thanks to NSSCaptain for raising this in [#386](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/issues/386).

This release also bumps eunomia to [0.3.15](https://github.com/zannagh/eunomia/releases/tag/v0.3.15), which publishes the Eunomia Paper plugin to Modrinth for all supported game versions including 26.3. The Armor Hider Paper plugin already bundles what it needs from Eunomia, so Paper servers don't need a separate Eunomia install - by @zannagh in [#393](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/393). Thanks to MoShafiq98 for raising this in [#389](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/issues/389).

releases.notes:
## What's Changed

### Features
#### Elytra Settings
The Elytra settings (opacity slider + glint toggle) have been moved to their own row and are now decoupled from the chestplate settings. If you've previously had "Opacity affecting Elytra" enabled, Armor Hider will migrate your settings over from the chestplate settings.
In addition, a toggle "Elytra In Flight" has been added that allows you to opt-out of the default behavior which forces the Elytra to render while you're gliding. Switching this setting off, will - based on your settings - keep the Elytra hidden while gliding. Thanks to 이슬 for the idea via Discord - by @zannagh in [#325](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/325)

#### Settings Location
It is now possible to use three settings locations for Armor Hider's configuration via the 'Other Settings' screen. The previously available options options screen (to have a dedicated button on the options screen), skin customization (to have the settings inject into the skin customization screen), have now been extended by "Hidden", which removes both of the existing ones and only makes Armor Hider Settings accessible via the keybind (so MC's UI stays vanilla). Thanks to 이슬 for the idea via Discord - by @zannagh in [#326](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/326)

### Fixes
#### NeoForge 1.21.1 Female Gender Mod
On Neo 1.21.1 with Female Gender Mod, the chest of the player model is now correctly rendered with the chest opacity set to 0%. It is known that translucency does not work on this mod/game version combination and also not planned to be added. Thanks to josh for the report via Discord - by @zannagh in [#327](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/327)

### Other
Some improvements were made to the test structure of the mod, introducing coverage reports and making smoke tests (which assert actual rendering instead of synthetic small unit tests) a lot quicker to execute + make them executable on a CI runner - by @zannagh in [#320](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/320) and [#321](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/pull/321)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/compare/v0.12.13...v0.12.14

releases.notes:
## What's Changed

### Features
#### Elytra Trims Compat
Not really a feature here, but a lot of investigation went into how enabling transparency with ElytraTrims could go - and it doesn't really go. Could not figure out a smart way to redraw transparency on trims on the elytra, hence the mod continues to only hide/show Elytras with ElytraTrims being present client side.

#### GeckoLib Compat
Any mod using default GeckoLib behavior to draw armor should now be compatible to Armor Hider. Of course, there are going to be edge cases (and I can only test so much), but in principle, the rendering pipes through AH's interceptions correctly. If you are using a GeckoLib-using armor mod that doesn't work as expected, feel free to notify me via Discord or GitHub.

#### Fantasy Armor Compat
Fantasy Armor (interestingly) decides to hide player arms. A dedicated compat was added that re-enables the arms if the armor is only partially rendered or hidden.

#### LuckPerms Compat
Armor Hider now supports LuckPerms. You can add the 'armorhider.admin' permission to any player or group to let players change Armor Hider settings server-wide. In case LuckPerms is present on the server, the mod will prefer to use its permission settings, but otherwise fall back to the default "any mod or admin can edit server-wide settings" behavior from before.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/compare/v0.10.2...v0.10.3
